policy: Official style files are fetched on demand, SHA-256 verified, and never edited. They are not redistributed here: the ACL style repository carries no explicit licence file, and IEEEtran is easy to fetch from CTAN. Only the original skeleton wrappers in templates/<family>/ ship with the skill. Venue families without a verified stable archive are imported from a local copy with --from and verified against the pinned SHA-256; copying them into templates/<family>/vendor/ (--vendor) is an explicit, opt-in decision about redistribution rights.

acl.notes: Check the current call for papers: page limits, the mandatory Limitations section, the Responsible NLP checklist (submitted through the review system, not in the PDF), and the AI-writing-assistance policy.

ieee.citation_style: numeric, \cite with the cite package; bibliography style IEEEtran
ieee.license: LPPL 1.3 (the IEEEtran class); do not rename or edit the class file
ieee.notes: ICASSP and Interspeech publish a new author kit every year. When the call for papers supplies one, take its preamble and keep the section inputs from this skeleton.

icml.license: no explicit redistribution licence found; used unmodified
icml.notes: Official ICML 2026 archive, verified byte-identical to the copy in the reference skill. Impact Statement is required at the end of the paper.

iclr.license: no explicit redistribution licence found; used unmodified
iclr.notes: Official ICLR Master Template archive. Camera-ready uses \iclrfinalcopy (our wrapper issues it when \camerareadytrue). LLM-use disclosure goes in a separate appendix section.

colm.notes: The pinned official repository now holds the 2026 template (newer than the 2025 copy in some bundles). For another year, download that year's kit and re-pin with --trust-new-hash.

neurips.local_hint: Download the style file from the official page (or use an existing copy) and pass its folder with --from. The file is installed as neurips_2025.sty.
neurips.notes: No stable archive URL could be verified. The hash pins the NeurIPS 2025 style file; for a later year download the new kit and re-pin with --trust-new-hash. The paper checklist goes after the references.

aaai.citation_style: natbib; the style file sets the bibliography style itself
aaai.local_hint: Download the AAAI author kit from the official page and pass the folder containing aaai2026.sty and aaai2026.bst with --from.
aaai.notes: AAAI is strict: no hyperref, geometry, fullpage, float, fontenc; no \newpage or \clearpage; never add \bibliographystyle. venue_check.py scans for these.

icassp.where: Author kit linked from the conference website's paper-submission page (usually spconf.sty and IEEEbib.bst).

interspeech.where: Author kit linked from the conference website's paper-submission page.
